import sys, base64, struct, io, csv, json
sys.path.insert(0, '/tmp/dev'); sys.path.insert(0, '/workspace/deps')
from harness import *
import zstandard as zstd

ok = True
L = lease('home', '2001:db8:1:1200::/56', 0, 100, (0,), 2)
T1 = '2001:db8:1:1200::1'
S = {'web': 'tcp'}
GOOD = [icmp('i', 0, 5, 'put', 'home', 3, '0/i1', T1, T1, 'echo')]

def err(job):
    got, _ = run(job)
    return got

# zstd round trip
got, _ = run(campaign([L], S, [10], [make_capture(GOOD, 'zstd')]))
ok &= check('zstd ok', got['snapshots'][0]['ledger']['live'], 1)

# chunks split mid-codepoint / mid-record
text = rows_to_csv(GOOD)
data = text.encode('utf-8')
cap = {'encoding': 'csv', 'chunks': [b64(data[:3]), b64(data[3:7]), b64(data[7:])]}
got, _ = run(campaign([L], S, [10], [cap]))
ok &= check('split chunks', got['snapshots'][0]['ledger']['live'], 1)

# empty chunks allowed
cap = {'encoding': 'csv', 'chunks': ['', b64(data), '']}
got, _ = run(campaign([L], S, [10], [cap]))
ok &= check('empty chunks', got['snapshots'][0]['ledger']['live'], 1)

# quoted fields with newlines
rows = [icmp('i', 0, 5, 'put', 'home', 3, '0/i1', T1, T1, 'echo')]
text = rows_to_csv(rows)
alt = 'type,id,revision,published,op,lease,event,probe,target,responder,result,service,attempt,payload\r\n' + \
      'icmp,"i",0,5,put,home,3,"0/i1","%s","%s",echo,,,\r\n' % (T1, T1)
cap = {'encoding': 'csv', 'chunks': [b64(alt.encode())]}
got, _ = run(campaign([L], S, [10], [cap]))
ok &= check('quoted crlf', got['snapshots'][0]['ledger']['live'], 1)

# blank logical data record is malformed and counted
alt = rows_to_csv(GOOD) + '\n'
cap = {'encoding': 'csv', 'chunks': [b64(alt.encode())]}
got, _ = run(campaign([L], S, [10], [cap]))
ok &= check('blank record rejected', got['rejected'], [[0, 1]])

# invalid base64
cap = {'encoding': 'csv', 'chunks': ['!!!!']}
ok &= check('bad base64', err(campaign([L], S, [10], [cap])), {'error': 'capture'})

# non-standard base64
cap = {'encoding': 'csv', 'chunks': [base64.b64encode(data).decode().replace('/', '_')]}
ok &= check('urlsafe base64', err(campaign([L], S, [10], [cap])), {'error': 'capture'})

# invalid utf-8
cap = {'encoding': 'csv', 'chunks': [b64(b'\xff\xfe\x00')]}
ok &= check('bad utf8', err(campaign([L], S, [10], [cap])), {'error': 'capture'})

# wrong header
cap = {'encoding': 'csv', 'chunks': [b64(b'type,id\r\nicmp,x\r\n')]}
ok &= check('bad header', err(campaign([L], S, [10], [cap])), {'error': 'capture'})

# no header at all
cap = {'encoding': 'csv', 'chunks': [b64(b'')]}
ok &= check('empty stream', err(campaign([L], S, [10], [cap])), {'error': 'capture'})

# syntactically invalid csv after rejected rows
bad = rows_to_csv(GOOD) + 'icmp,"x"y,0,5,delete,,,,,,,,\n'
cap = {'encoding': 'csv', 'chunks': [b64(bad.encode())]}
ok &= check('csv strict', err(campaign([L], S, [10], [cap])), {'error': 'capture'})

# zstd truncation
zdata = zstd.ZstdCompressor().compress(text.encode())
cap = {'encoding': 'zstd', 'chunks': [b64(zdata[:-4])]}
ok &= check('zstd truncated', err(campaign([L], S, [10], [cap])), {'error': 'capture'})

# zstd checksum error
zck = bytearray(zstd.ZstdCompressor(write_checksum=True).compress(text.encode()))
zck[-1] ^= 0xff
cap = {'encoding': 'zstd', 'chunks': [b64(bytes(zck))]}
ok &= check('zstd checksum', err(campaign([L], S, [10], [cap])), {'error': 'capture'})

# zstd garbage magic
cap = {'encoding': 'zstd', 'chunks': [b64(b'abcdefgh' * 4)]}
ok &= check('zstd garbage', err(campaign([L], S, [10], [cap])), {'error': 'capture'})

# skippable frames
skip = struct.pack('<II', 0x184d2a50, 3) + b'abc'
cap = {'encoding': 'zstd', 'chunks': [b64(skip + zdata + skip)]}
got, _ = run(campaign([L], S, [10], [cap]))
ok &= check('zstd skippable', got['snapshots'][0]['ledger']['live'], 1)

# zstd with reserved frame bit
badz = bytearray(zdata)
badz[4] |= 0x08
cap = {'encoding': 'zstd', 'chunks': [b64(bytes(badz))]}
ok &= check('zstd reserved bit', err(campaign([L], S, [10], [cap])), {'error': 'capture'})

# zstd with unused frame bit ignored
goodz = bytearray(zdata)
goodz[4] |= 0x10
cap = {'encoding': 'zstd', 'chunks': [b64(bytes(goodz))]}
got, _ = run(campaign([L], S, [10], [cap]))
ok &= check('zstd unused bit', got['snapshots'][0]['ledger']['live'], 1)

# field longer than budget
big = rows_to_csv(GOOD).replace('0/i1', 'x' * 200000)
cap = {'encoding': 'csv', 'chunks': [b64(big.encode())]}
ok &= check('field budget', err(campaign([L], S, [10], [cap])), {'error': 'capture'})

# too many logical data records
many = rows_to_csv([icmp('r%d' % i, 0, 5, 'put', 'home', 3, '0/i1', T1, T1, 'echo')
                    for i in range(200001)])
cap = {'encoding': 'csv', 'chunks': [b64(many.encode())]}
ok &= check('record budget', err(campaign([L], S, [10], [cap])), {'error': 'capture'})

# metadata error takes precedence over a bad capture
job = campaign([L], S, [10], [{'encoding': 'csv', 'chunks': ['!']}])
job['version'] = 2
ok &= check('metadata precedence', err(job), {'error': 'invalid'})

# too many chunks
caps = [{'encoding': 'csv', 'chunks': [''] * 1025}]
ok &= check('chunk count', err(campaign([L], S, [10], caps)), {'error': 'invalid'})

# metadata validation
base = campaign([L], S, [10], [make_capture(GOOD)])
for name, mutate in [
    ('version', lambda j: j.update(version=4)),
    ('seed', lambda j: j.update(seed='bad seed!')),
    ('seed type', lambda j: j.update(seed=3)),
    ('extra key', lambda j: j.update(extra=1)),
    ('missing key', lambda j: j.pop('offers')),
    ('queries empty', lambda j: j.update(queries=[])),
    ('queries dup', lambda j: j.update(queries=[10, 10])),
    ('queries bool', lambda j: j.update(queries=[True])),
    ('queries float', lambda j: j.update(queries=[10.0])),
    ('lease start>=end', lambda j: j['leases'][0].update(start=100, end=100)),
    ('lease end too big', lambda j: j['leases'][0].update(end=10**12 + 2)),
    ('lease prefix host bits', lambda j: j['leases'][0].update(prefix='2001:db8:1:1200::1/56')),
    ('lease prefix len', lambda j: j['leases'][0].update(prefix='2001:db8:1::/48')),
    ('lease prefix out of range', lambda j: j['leases'][0].update(prefix='2001:db9::/56')),
    ('lease subnet too big', lambda j: j['leases'][0].update(prefix='2001:db8:1:1200::/56', subnets=[256])),
    ('lease subnet dup', lambda j: j['leases'][0].update(subnets=[0, 0])),
    ('lease /64 subnet nonzero', lambda j: j['leases'][0].update(prefix='2001:db8:1:1200::/64', subnets=[1])),
    ('lease low_count', lambda j: j['leases'][0].update(low_count=33)),
    ('lease id', lambda j: j['leases'][0].update(id='has space')),
    ('lease dup id', lambda j: j['leases'].append(dict(j['leases'][0]))),
    ('service kind', lambda j: j['services'][0].update(kind='udp')),
    ('request lease', lambda j: j['requests'][0].update(lease='nope')),
    ('request at not query', lambda j: j['requests'][0].update(at=11)),
    ('request group', lambda j: j['requests'][0].update(group='nope')),
    ('request target out of doc', lambda j: j['requests'][0].update(target='2001:db9::1')),
    ('request target zone', lambda j: j['requests'][0].update(target='2001:db8::1%eth0')),
    ('offer capacity', lambda j: j['offers'][0].update(capacity=4097)),
    ('offer cost', lambda j: j['offers'][0].update(cost=-1)),
    ('offer prefix strict', lambda j: j['offers'][0].update(prefix='2001:db8:1:1200::1/64')),
    ('offer prefix short', lambda j: j['offers'][0].update(prefix='2001:db8::/24')),
    ('offer unknown request', lambda j: j['offers'][0].update(requests=['zz'])),
    ('offer dup request', lambda j: j['offers'][0].update(requests=['r1', 'r1'])),
    ('quota cycle', lambda j: j.update(request_quotas=[{'id': 'a', 'parent': 'b', 'capacity': 1},
                                                       {'id': 'b', 'parent': 'a', 'capacity': 1}])),
    ('quota deep', lambda j: j.update(request_quotas=[
        {'id': 'n%d' % i, 'parent': None if i == 0 else 'n%d' % (i - 1), 'capacity': 1}
        for i in range(34)])),
    ('quota capacity', lambda j: j['request_quotas'][0].update(capacity=4097)),
]:
    job = campaign([L], S, [10], [make_capture(GOOD)],
                   requests=[request('r1', 10, 'home', T1)],
                   offers=[offer('o1', 11, 'web', '2001:db8:1:1200::/64', 1, 7, 'q', ['r1'])])
    mutate(job)
    ok &= check('invalid: ' + name, err(job), {'error': 'invalid'})

# raw JSON problems
def raw(text):
    proc = __import__('subprocess').run(
        [sys.executable, '-I', '-B', '/workspace/submission/campaign.py'],
        input=text.encode(), stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE, cwd='/tmp')
    return json.loads(proc.stdout.decode())
ok &= check('bom', raw('﻿' + json.dumps(base)), {'error': 'invalid'})
ok &= check('trailing', raw(json.dumps(base) + ' {}'), {'error': 'invalid'})
ok &= check('dup key', raw(json.dumps(base)[:-1] + ',"version":3}'), {'error': 'invalid'})
ok &= check('nan', raw(json.dumps(base)[:-1] + ',"x":NaN}'), {'error': 'invalid'})
ok &= check('not object', raw('[1,2]'), {'error': 'invalid'})
ok &= check('empty', raw(''), {'error': 'invalid'})

print('ALL OK' if ok else 'FAILURES')
PYEOF
python3 t5.py 2>&1 | grep -E "^(FAIL|ALL)"; echo "---"; python3 t5.py 2>&1 | grep -c PASS
